column3: I first tried to go by position, always choosing left, but then I realized that that was not working and so I tried to figure out what strategy my partner was using. For a long time, I thought my partner was going by choosing the lighter color, but then that didn't fully work either and so I adapted into a routine of choosing whatever color my partner chose for that choice last time.
The strategy I used to maximize my report was to look for any patterns of which colors were matches and the frequency of these patterns
